title: Collateral default contract registration request event
description: This event occurs when a client request a register of collateral default contract.

systemId.title: System ID
systemId.description: Identifier of Pismo on Partner. Composition is prefix pismo + domain

bucketName.title: Bucket Name
bucketName.description: Is a name of storage where Partner will access to download files

typeCollateralEncumbranceCode.title: Type collateral encumbrance code
typeCollateralEncumbranceCode.description: Is a number that defines the type of default contract. 1-Assignment Fiduciary Alienation 3–Pledge

requesterId.title: Requester ID
requesterId.description: Is a identifier from who is requesting the register of a default contract as according with partner this requesterId is our issuerId

externalId.title: External ID
externalId.description: External identifier for operation provided by client.

correlationId.title: Correlation ID
correlationId.description: External identifier for a request provided by client or by us. This ID will be used handle response events from Partner.
